title: Checkpoint: Three Contracts

tests.name: ratio parser
tests.hint: Split on ':' — exactly 2 parts, both int.TryParse, both > 0. Assign out params before every return.

tests.name: swap with history
tests.hint: Static counter incremented per call; (a, b) = (b, a) does the swap.

tests.name: bounded flatten
tests.hint: Recursion on (depth - 1); base case depth <= 0 returns 0; ints count only at depth >= 1.
